item.title: Soft Eyes, Sweeter Heart: Meet Snow
item.description: Meet Snow, our Wet Nose Wednesday Pet of the Week! This gentle 9-year-old hound mix is ready for her forever home. Learn how you can adopt or help her today.

item.title: In the Weeds with the Missouri Department of Conservation
item.description: Join Grace as she chats with Sara Karnes from the MDC about all the exciting events happening this month. From virtual programs like fish cleaning and morel mushroom hunting to guided hikes on the Wildcat Trail and Wildflower Nature Hike, there’s something for everyone. Bring the kids for free spring break hatchery tours, try wildflower bingo, or learn falconry with expert Megan Duffy Yates.

item.title: Meet Rowdy: Zoomies, Snuggles, and Endless Love
item.description: Meet Rowdy, a 4-year-old tricolor hound mix who’s equal parts playful goofball and devoted cuddle buddy. Loves zoomies, adventures, and snuggles with his favorite humans

item.title: Early Detection & Local Support: How BCFO Helps Families Fight Breast Cancer
item.description: Discover how the Breast Cancer Foundation of the Ozarks supports local families, from paying bills during treatment to free mammograms, and don’t miss their emotional ‘A Time to Share’ Fashion Show on April 23, 2026. Learn how you can help at bcfo.org.

item.title: Milk, Eggs, & 5 Generations of Grit: The Justin Raef Story
item.description: On Beyond the Gate, Jamie talks with Justin Raef, a fifth-generation Missouri dairyman and poultry producer, about the grit, family teamwork, and daily grind of running a Century Farm in 2026.

item.title: Looking for Love? Jethro Wants His Fur-ever Home!
item.description: Meet Jethro, a sweet 2.8-year-old Shepherd mix and this week’s Wet Nose Wednesday pet! Learn how you can help him find his fur-ever home and make a difference for local adoptable dogs.

item.title: Immediate Support for Fallen Heroes: The Greene County 100 Club 🚔🚒
item.description: Learn how the Greene County 100 Club supports families of fallen first responders with immediate, no-strings-attached financial help, helping them focus on healing and honoring their loved ones.

item.title: Easter Fun Around the Ozarks: Family-Friendly Events You Can’t Miss
item.description: Celebrate Easter around the Ozarks! Discover Six family-friendly, affordable events, from egg hunts and crafts to indoor and pool adventures, perfect for kids and parents alike.

item.title: Community Strong: Supporting Our Fallen Heroes
item.description: A powerful community fundraiser in the Ozarks honors fallen deputies Gabriel Ramirez and Michael Hislope with a car show, live music, auctions, and more at Ozark Mountain Sports Complex on March 29.

item.title: NFL Legend Rob Gronkowski is Coming to Springfield! 🏈
item.description: The Boys & Girls Clubs of Springfield hosts its 26th Annual Steak & Steak Dinner on April 7, featuring NFL champion Rob Gronkowski. Enjoy dinner, auctions, and more while supporting nearly 6,000 local kids.
